conventions.S: volume-integral of omega_i omega_j d_j u_i
conventions.Q_shape: S * L^1.5 / E^1.5 with L=2pi; amplitude- and nu-independent
conventions.identity: R_stretching = Q_shape * Re_E^-3 exactly (algebra, not a fit)
conventions.bound: dE/dt <= C * E^3 / nu^3 (Lu & Doering 2008); C NOT verified here

invariance_sweep.field: random_spectrum slope=5/3 seed=101, enstrophy normalized to E=1
invariance_sweep.note: Q is invariant under u -> lambda u and under nu; R_S = Q*Re_E^-3
